standard_prerequisites.name: Uniqueness of solutions
standard_prerequisites.use: Solutions are unique up to unique isomorphism and have vanishing negative exts.

standard_prerequisites.name: Finite glueing
standard_prerequisites.use: Existence for systems on a space with a finite covering.

standard_prerequisites.name: Glueing along increasing unions
standard_prerequisites.use: Existence along well-ordered increasing unions with compatible isomorphisms.

core_obligations: Uniqueness from Lemma uniqueness; if X has a finite covering by elements of B, the theorem follows from Lemma solution-in-finite-case (proof lines 11478-11489).

Transfinite choice of opens W_α: W_0 = ∅, successors add some U_α not contained in W_β, limit ordinals take unions; each S_α = ({K_U}, {ρ^U_V}) over B_α is a system as in the uniqueness lemma on W_α (proof lines 11490-11510).

Successor step: augment B_α with W_β (condition (3) preserved by the uniqueness lemma applied to K_{W_β}) and reduce to the case handled in the finite-case lemma with W_α = W_β ∪ U_α (proof lines 11511-11536).

Limit step: for γ < β < α the restrictions K_{W_β}|_{W_γ} are solutions of S_γ, so uniqueness gives isomorphisms ρ^{W_β}_{W_γ} composing correctly; apply glueing-increasing-union (negative exts vanish by the uniqueness lemma) to obtain K_{W_α} (proof lines 11537-11570).

Compatibility of the assembled system maps with the given ρ^U_V — the source summarizes the final bookkeeping (details of the compatibility checks are omitted); this is the part needing human spot-checking (proof lines 11571-11589).
proof_roadmap: Settle uniqueness and the finite case.
Choose the transfinite filtration of X.
Successor step: reduce to the two-open case.
difficulty_reason: Uniqueness comes from the uniqueness lemma and the finite case from the finite-case lemma; the general case is a transfinite induction whose successor step reduces to the two-open case and whose limit step assembles the solutions over the increasing union via glueing-increasing-union; the final compatibility bookkeeping is partially omitted in the source.
